name: GP prediction-error model
description: Empirical SGP4 prediction error by orbit regime and prediction age, in RTN. Element sets are propagated to later element sets of the same object (consecutive-set differences, which are not truth) or to independent reference states (GCRF, from analysis/reference-states). Batches accumulate counts, moments and histograms; finalize gives mean, covariance, quantiles, robust sigma and clipped covariance per stratum. With a model on accumulate (reference mode), each error is also tested against its stratum's model covariance (Mahalanobis d^2 against chi-square with 3 degrees of freedom, every sample counted) and finalize gates each stratum CALIBRATED, FAILED or INSUFFICIENT; scale_model fits per-stratum scale factors to reference-state errors. screening_evaluation scores a probabilistic (Foster Pc), a bounded-set and a possibility (admissible-set) screening rule on independent cases built from reference-state errors with synthetic true misses. hpop_arcs and hpop_coverage calibrate HPOP covariance (P0 at the element-set epoch, white-acceleration process noise) against reference states.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic SGP4 propagation and statistics over caller-supplied element sets and reference states. No host calls, threads or network access; batches are combined through the prior accumulator.

inputPorts.description: Size-prefixed $OMM records, concatenated, SGP4 mean elements; every element set of each object in the batch (objects are not split across batches). Epochs within one second are one element set republished: the later record is kept.
Independent reference states ($OEM, GCRF, UTC, OBJECT.NORAD_CAT_ID), e.g. analysis/reference-states output. When present, errors are taken against these instead of later element sets.
